title: MEG component diagram
description: MEG: the game is one static page run in the browser, served behind icelander.net's sign-in by a Worker that also keeps the shared high-score table.

components.name: MEG
components.responsibility: One game: the browser page and its Worker, built and deployed together.

components.name: Browser game
components.responsibility: public/: the page, its stylesheet and meg.js, which holds input, the simulation of the shark and the eight files, canvas drawing, synthesized audio, the HUD and the menus.

components.name: Worker
components.responsibility: worker/: sends anyone signed out to sign in before serving the page, runs the high-score API and public scores page, and serves every other file as a static asset.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Says who is signed in and with which games: roles.

components.name: Google Fonts
components.responsibility: Serves Lilita One, Nunito and Special Elite for the titles and buttons, the HUD and menus, and the incident files.

components.name: Browser localStorage
components.responsibility: Keeps the highest incident file reached, the sound setting, the last name entered, and a copy of this device's best scores.

components.name: ScoreTable Durable Object
components.responsibility: The shared table: run tickets and the best hundred scores (worker/scores.ts).

relationships.description: Serves the page and its files from the ASSETS binding.
Checks the site_session cookie through the ACCOUNTS service binding.
Loads the three fonts with a stylesheet link; falls back to system fonts without them.
Reads and writes meg.unlocked, meg.muted, meg.scores and meg.name, and plays on without them if storage is blocked.
Durable Object binding SCORES: issues tickets, takes scores, reads the table.
POST api/run when a run starts, POST api/score when it ends, GET api/scores for the table.
